title: wktest-promote
desc: Staging binary promotion: wktest-core-*.exe to bin/wkappbot-core.exe after smoke gate.

FEATURE 2026-07-03: added a post-hotswap Eye-path stability check (best-effort, non-gating) to wktest-promote.sh. After a successful promotion, it triggers 'eye tick' then writes a canary file through the Eye-delegated path, verifying both that the write landed AND that the '[FILE] write OK' stderr confirmation actually reached the caller. Motivated by finding that Eye-delegated wkappbot file write always succeeded but sometimes silently dropped the stderr confirmation message in relay -- this surfaces that gap automatically instead of relying on a user filing a false 'writes are broken' bug.
